sloka: न तु रामम् विना देहे तिष्ठेत्तु मम जीवितम् ।तदलम् त्यज्यतामेष निश्चयः पापनिश्चये ॥२-१२-१४॥
transliteration: na tu rāmam vinā dehe tiṣṭhettu mama jīvitam ।tadalam tyajyatāmeṣa niścayaḥ pāpaniścaye ॥2-12-14॥

translations.english: O lady of evil intentions, enough of this. Give up your resolve. Here I touch your feet with my head. Be pleased with me.
